investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Willowbrook Press (news and media publishing); Platform: AWS eu-central-1 (zones eu-central-1a/eu-central-1b/eu-central-1c); network range 10.54.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster willow-prod-eucent (EKS); Database: mysql server image-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-718a2f5ba8aa3f42b; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
